description:
Cast The Trickster God's Heist by paying {2}{U}{B}, causing its first chapter ability to trigger when it enters.
Resolve the chapter ability, exchanging control of a creature an opponent controls and Old Fat Spider.
Cast Orcish Bowmasters by paying {1}{B}.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters, it triggers, targeting Old Fat Spider.
Old Fat Spider's last ability triggers, causing its controller to draw a card.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers, targeting Old Fat Spider.
Repeat from step 5 until the opponent loses the game due to drawing from an empty library.
